text: Hi — could you confirm something in writing for me? I heard that Professor Alvarez's faculty senate meeting this Wednesday at 10:00 is cancelled this week. Is that right? I'm about to ask him for a 30-minute meeting at that hour, and I don't want to build on a rumour.

No — nothing has been cancelled or moved this week. The faculty senate is on as scheduled, Wed 10:00–11:00. A cancellation only counts when this office confirms it in writing, and none has been issued.

One thing to keep in mind: that hour is a scheduled governance duty, and those come before a 1:1. You may want to check Professor Alvarez's calendar for genuinely free time before asking.

Professor Alvarez — about the 30-minute meeting I wanted to set up for Wednesday at 10:00: I checked with the department office, and the faculty senate meeting that hour is **still on** (they confirmed in writing that nothing was cancelled or moved this week), so I won't ask for that hour — governance duties come first anyway.

Sorry about the mix-up; I must have got it wrong when we spoke in the hallway. Could we find another slot this week instead? Some times that suit me (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00): Tuesday 14:00, Thursday 15:00, Friday 11:00 — all 30 minutes, and I can shift around your lectures and office hours, so tell me what actually works for you and I'll book it.

— Diego
Thanks — good to know. I won't ask him for that hour.
You're welcome. If you need a free slot for the 30 minutes, I can tell you which times on the official schedule are open.

That would help — thank you. Of the times I proposed to him (Tuesday 14:00, Thursday 15:00, Friday 11:00, each 30 minutes), which are open on the official schedule for a student meeting? I've asked him to pick one; I just want to offer him times that don't clash with a governance duty.

Unfortunately none of the three are free on the official schedule:

- Tue 14:00 — overlaps the thesis committee, 13:00–15:00
- Thu 15:00 — overlaps the seminar, 14:00–15:30
- Fri 11:00 — overlaps the CSE455 lecture, 10:30–12:00

Free 30 minutes on the official schedule this week: Mon 10:00, 12:00–15:00 or 16:30 · Tue 09:00, 11:00–13:00, 15:00 or 16:30 · Wed 11:00–14:00 or 15:00 · Thu 10:30–14:00 or 15:30 · Fri 09:00, 12:00–15:00 or 16:00.

Also worth remembering: office hours are open to students — Mon 09:00–10:00 and Wed 15:30–17:00 — so a 1:1 can simply go there. And a meeting is only booked once it's on every participant's calendar, so please confirm with him rather than assuming.

Thanks for checking with the office, Diego — and no harm done.

I'm afraid none of your three times is free on my side:
- Tue 14:00 — Thesis committee, 13:00–15:00
- Thu 15:00 — Seminar, 14:00–15:30
- Fri 11:00 — CSE455 lecture, 10:30–12:00

What does work, all 30 minutes, inside 09:00–17:00:
- Tuesday 15:00–15:30 (today)
- Wednesday 12:30–13:00
- Thursday 12:00–12:30
- Friday 12:00–12:30

Take whichever suits you, ideally not the first if you can help it, and confirm — I'll put it on my calendar and log it once you do.

Prof. Alvarez — correction to my earlier note: the three slots I offered clash with your own commitments (Tue 14:00 thesis committee, Thu 15:00 seminar, Fri 11:00 CSE455 lecture). Sorry.

The department office says these are free on the official schedule for a 30-minute meeting: Mon 10:00 or 12:00–15:00 or 16:30 · Tue 09:00, 11:00–13:00, 15:00 or 16:30 · Wed 11:00–14:00 or 15:00 · Thu 10:30–14:00 or 15:30 · Fri 09:00, 12:00–15:00 or 16:00.

Could I take **Wednesday 11:00–11:30** (or 12:00 if you prefer)? If it's easier, I can just come to your office hours (Mon 09:00–10:00, Wed 15:30–17:00) instead — whichever you'd rather. I'll put it on my calendar and log it once you confirm.

— Diego
Very helpful — thank you. I've passed the free windows to him and asked for Wed 11:00–11:30; I'll confirm with him before treating it as booked. Noted that his office hours are open to students too.
Good — Wed 11:00–11:30 is free on the official schedule. Once he agrees, write to me if you'd like it noted. Good luck.

Let's take **Wednesday 12:30–13:00** then — it's free on the official schedule too (office said Wed 11:00–14:00 is open), so it's not your first option and not one of your teaching or governance hours.

So: 30 minutes, Wed 18 Nov, 12:30–13:00. I'm putting it on my calendar now and logging it. If anything changes on your side, just say and I'll move it.

— Diego

Final slot: we settled on **Wednesday 18 Nov, 12:30–13:00**, 30 minutes — free on the official schedule and no clash with his teaching or governance duties. He's agreed in writing and is putting it on his calendar; could you note it on the official record? Thanks for the help.

Diego — Wed 11:00 doesn't work, and 12:00 doesn't either: 11:00–12:30 is Grant writing on my calendar, and it isn't an event the office schedules, so it wouldn't show in their list.

But your own window covers it: **Wednesday 12:30–13:00** is free on my side and inside the 11:00–14:00 you gave. Shall we take that? If you'd rather not, Thursday 12:00–12:30 works too.

You're welcome to come to office hours instead (Mon 09:00–10:00, Wed 15:30–17:00) — but those are open to everyone, so if you want a guaranteed 30 minutes of my attention, book the 12:30 slot. Confirm and I'll log it.
Also on the record: I asked the department office to note Wed 18 Nov 12:30–13:00 as our meeting, so it's logged with them too. See you Wednesday.

Yes — **Wed 18 Nov, 12:30–13:00** it is. That's what I've just booked and logged on my side, and I've asked the department office to note it on the official record. No office hours needed; see you Wednesday.

Confirmed: Wed 12:30–13:00 doesn't clash with anything on the official schedule — the nearest official events are the faculty senate 10:00–11:00 and the department meeting 14:00–15:00.

One note: the official record holds the department's events (lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, senate, committees, department meetings), so a 1:1 with a student isn't entered there — it lives in your calendar and his. Keep the note there, and since he's agreed in writing, it's booked once it's on both calendars. If either of you ever needs to change it, log the change the same way.

Understood — thanks for the confirmation that 12:30–13:00 is clear, and noted that the official record only holds department events. It's in my calendar and his, so it's booked; any change I'll log the same way.
Confirmed on my side too: **Wed 18 Nov, 12:30–13:00**, 30 minutes, on my calendar and logged. Good of you to have it noted with the office. See you Wednesday.
Perfect — see you Wednesday at 12:30. Thanks, Professor.
